question: Modern urine pregnancy tests can detect hCG at concentrations as low as 25 IU/L, making them positive even before a missed period in some women.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This is TRUE. Sensitive urine tests detect hCG at 25 IU/L or lower. hCG is first detectable ~8–10 days post-fertilisation and reaches urine test threshold shortly after, often before the missed period.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct! Most modern urine pregnancy tests have a sensitivity of 25 IU/L (some 10–20 IU/L). Since hCG rises rapidly after implantation (doubling every ~48 hours), tests can become positive 1–2 days before the expected period in some women.
